text: Ko wano Men wahayinirnoo e ɓeya Annabaaɓe adinooɓe ma ɓen, Men wahayiniri e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, janngeteende e haala aarabu, fii ko jertiniraa yimɓe Makka ɓen e aarabuuɓe wonɓe takko mayre ɓen, refti yimɓe ɓen fow. Jertinaa kadi yimɓe ɓen, fii Ñalande Darngal, ñalnde Allah mooɓoyta adinooɓe e sakkitiiɓe fow nokku gooto, fii ñaaweede yoɓee; ñalaande nde sikke alaa e mu'un. Yimɓe ɓen wonoyay pecce ɗiɗi: feccere goo, ka Aljanna; woni muumini'en, ndeya feccere, ka Yiite; woni heeferɓe ɓen.
